node.title: THE RESIDUE: quantitative regime matching at FM-scale densities
node.statement: RESTRUCTURED: primary route = xr_globalness_from_ledger (the proved tangent ledger bounds link densities post-strip) + xr_small_set_engine (KLLM: global sets expand, losses poly in link parameters not 1/mu) + elementary composition arithmetic. The raw-KMS-constants check remains the cheap first look (the loss-exponent table), but the globalness route is expected to carry the FM-scale regime. If both compose, the XR wall's skeleton is an assembly of proved pieces plus one import. COMPOSITION TENSION (#211/E20): raw KMS/DKKMS do not provide a q-power FM engine as stated (verdict per the loss tables); KLLM's extracted stay-probability arithmetic consumes globalness beta <= q^-g and yields q^{-(g+t-1)/4} — a Q-POWER globalness demand, while the proved top-core cap gives poly(n)-scale. THE open arithmetic: does poly-globalness + the q-power pair ledger compose to n^B * FM (the KLLM engine used only for the structured residue), or does the cap need a q-power strengthening (a new, harder statement)? This is now the central question of the QX.14/QX.15 assembly.
node.attack_surface: parameter tables first (S-sized): tabulate the KMS/KLLM loss exponents against the FM gap per rate; if the exponents eat the gap, the KLLM global-hypercontractivity route is the fallback with sharper small-set constants
node.falsifier: the tables showing BOTH known quantitative forms lose more than the FM gap provides — would mean the import needs strengthening, not that the route is dead
node.notes: Globalness half PROOF-PINNED (see xr_globalness_from_ledger): the crux-1 conversion now has NO open conjecture of our own on the primary path — remaining: KLLM constant verification (QX.12), the E3-stability plumbing (wave-1 bridge packet), and the QX.14/QX.15 assembly. | Fleet A M3: the import skeleton encodes the decisive structural check — the chain is satisfiable ONLY IF the KLLM losses are mu-free AND the globalness definition is absolute (g3 + g1*g6 = 0). The eventual PDF verification is now a TWO-ITEM check (C2, C9), not a paper-wide audit. | FLIP on replay (Codex rednode wave 2): TARGET -> CONDITIONAL; packet in nodes/xr_kms_parameter_matching/. | REGRESSED PROVABLE -> CONDITIONAL: its predicate xr_globalness_from_ledger was honestly downgraded in wave 4; the discharge un-fires.
